_README: Copy the object below into the `goals[]` array in data/goals.json and edit it.
Do not leave this file's placeholder text in the site — replace every field.
Use a P- prefix for the id so personal goals sort apart from the G- system goals.
Keep the three `role: none` dependency entries: they render as '—' in the dependency
matrix and keep `node tools/validate.mjs` at zero warnings.
Personal goals take no tasks — a task's `system` must resolve to a registered system,
so put the steps in `definition_of_done` instead.
Delete `metric` entirely if the goal has nothing countable; the progress bar disappears
and that is correct. Never invent a number to fill it.

goal.title: One line, in the imperative — what will be true when this is done

metric.name: What is being counted
metric.note: Optional. Where the number came from, or why it is what it is.

goal.why: Why this matters, in your own words. Supports `code`, **bold**, *italic* and [links](https://example.com).
goal.plain: The same thing said to someone who does not work on this. Shown when the header toggle is set to plain voice.
goal.definition_of_done: The test that settles it. Written so someone else could check it without asking you.
